items.summary: The fleet is operationally saturated and under-actionable: 10/10 delivery slots are occupied, 39 improvements await measurement, 21 requests failed, 105 approved proposals lack execution requests, and only 64% of approved proposals have execution. Scheduler evidence shows 54 no-action ticks in 61 cycles, a 32-cycle no-action streak, and zero queue actions despite queue eligibility. Prioritize three reversible control-plane capabilities: canonical proposal-to-request reconciliation with deduplication and WIP/site-overlap limits; capability-aware task routing with explicit fallback and retry ownership; and scheduler actionability guardrails that require one bounded delivery, follow-up, or blocker action when execution is available. Preserve current security, launch, capacity, and measurement gates. Do not add telemetry, change schedules, deploy, or admit new implementation work until existing capacity and repair obligations clear.
